president.name: Paula Espada Blanco
president.bio: Hello! I'm Paula, a second-year HSPSer from Spain, and your JCR President for 2021. My role involves representing undergraduate Johnians and acting as a link between you and college. I sit on various committees, send many emails and do lots of admin... But most importantly, I oversee and support this fantastic Committee in every event or project we organise throughout the year. I love St John's and the Johnian community. Living here has been an incredible experience, and I want to help others feel as welcome and happy as I feel in college. I'll do my best to make the JCR as supportive and representative as possible, so please feel free to get in touch with any questions, ideas or suggestions. I'll be happy to help :)

vicepresident.name: William Tan
vicepresident.bio: Hi, I'm Will, a 2nd year medic and your 2021 Vice-President! As VP, I chair undergraduate Open Meetings, am responsible for the constitution and help out the president generally. I aim to uphold the cracker that is college life whilst ensuring the community is as inclusive and welcoming to everyone. My other big job is to organise Freshers' Week so please get in touch if you have any suggestions there, or just drop me a message with anything to take to college at all at wwwt2!

academic.name: James Perman
academic.bio: Hey, I'm James and I'm a first studying Biological Natural Sciences. I'm involved with college rugby and university volleyball and I'll be your Academic Affairs and Careers Officer this year. I hope to create an academic environment where the students feel comfortable and supported in both their degree and careers beyond university. If you have any questions, reach out and I'll be happy to try and help.

access.name: Felix Haynes
access.bio: Hi! I'm Felix, a second year studying HSPS, and your Access Officer this year! Part of my role involves working with the Admissions Office, Admissions Tutor, and the JCR to ensure John's is accessible to prospective students from a range of backgrounds, and sharing opportunities for current students to get involved (you can find out more about these in the [John's Access] group!). The other part of my role focuses on post-admission access, providing advice and resources to current students, and ensuring college remains a place where everyone is supported. Outside of the JCR, I help to run access initiatives for the wider university, and am involved with various fundraising initiatives in Cambridge. Please do get in touch if you have any concerns, or are interested in getting involved with access at John's!

bme.name: Maryam Khan
bme.bio: Hi! I'm Maryam, I'm a first-year HSPS student and your Ethnic Minorities Officer for this year! I want to make sure all ethnic minority Johnians feel safe and happy in college. I also want to ensure our culture and heritage is celebrated through different events within the college. Along with this, I want to focus on access and support for ethnic minority students who want to apply to Johns. Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions, concerns, or suggestions!

computing.name: Jan Derlatka
computing.bio: Hi, I'm Jan, a first year Engineering student and your Computing Officer for this year! I'm involved in University ski racing, train triathlon and before coming to Cambridge I had studied Computer Science for a year. As Computing Officer I am responsible for technical aspects of the JCR operation, right now I am developing an online ticketing system for JCR events. If you have any ideas on what else we could create I will be more than happy to hear from you! I also act as a connection between the student body and the IT department, ensuring that important improvements desired by students, are acted upon.

disabilities.name: Pollyanna Hopkins
disabilities.bio: Hi I am Pollyanna Hopkins and I am your Disabilities Officer this year. I am passionate about making the transition to university life as smooth as possible for all disabled students. I am here to facilitate arrangements needed for students' disabilities regarding any area of college life. This includes ease of mobility around the college, ensuring accessibility in the new buttery/dining room refurbishments, accommodating learning issues, and mental wellbeing. I'll also liaise with University-level bodies like the Disability Resource Centre and the SU's Disabled Students Campaign to ensure students are supported outside the college too. I am particularly keen to assist students with disabilities in securing suitable accommodation outside of the room ballot, as well as the necessary exam arrangements in Lent and Easter terms. Please don't hesitate to get in touch with any queries or issues, I look forward to working with you all this year!

ents.name: Emily Cavannah
ents.bio: Hi, I'm Emily, I'm the Ents officer on this year's JCR and I'm a second year Engling. My role is to host and organise the social events in term. From theming parities to ordering drinks, I'm pretty much the manager for everyones' social life here at John's so please do not hesitate to get in touch if you have any questions, comments or queries for me!

ethical.name: Annabel Poon
ethical.bio: Hi, I'm Annabel and I'm your Ethical & Charitable Affairs Officer for this year! I'm a second year studying Medicine. I also sit on the committees for SJC PuntSoc and SJC Medsoc, and am involved in Uni hockey. My role involves encouraging environmentally sustainable practices and promoting the work of charitable organisations among the undergraduate community here at John's. If you have any suggestions for events or ideas that you want to discuss, please feel free to contact me!

equalops.name: Ariana Zarrabian
equalops.bio: Hi, I'm Ariana, a second year History and Politics student and your Equal Opportunities Officer for this year! I'm also Co-Social Sec for women's hockey in college and Treasurer for the SJC History Society. As the Equal Opps Officer, I am responsible for everyone to feel that John's is a welcoming, non-discriminatory environment with equal access to matters ranging from accommodation to placement schemes. Working closely with the Liberation Officers and the Access Officer, I am here to ensure concerns are addressed as well as increase and celebrate diversity at John's. So, if you have any suggestions or concerns, please email me or drop me a message!

facilities.name: Ed Smith
facilities.bio: Yello, I'm Ed, I'm a first year Philosophy student and honoured to be your Facilities Officer this year. Catch me playing rugby for the Redboys and hockey for the Mogs. My job encompasses the Bar, Buttery, Fitness Centre, Weights Room and Laundry Room, and I hope to use my influence to get these back up and running in all their glory as soon as possible. If you have any general queries or ideas on how to improve any of these facilities, please feel free to either swing us an email, use the form on the JCR website found here, or drop an angry anonymous letter in my pidge.

internationals.name: Anna-Maria Papameletiou
internationals.bio: Hey! My name is Anna-Maria, and I'm a Second-Year Biological Natural Sciences student from Greece. In my free time, I enjoy playing hockey for College. I'm very excited to be your International Students' Officer this year. I'm here to help out international students by representing them in the JCR committee and providing them with support and information. I'll also be organising International Freshers' Week in September. I know that going to University in a different country can come with various challenges, so if you have any questions for me or want a chat, feel free to get in touch!

lgbtq.name: Emilie Walker
lgbtq.bio: Hi! I'm Emilie (she/her), a second-year BioNatSci and your LGBT+ Officer! As LGBT+ officer, I am focusing on welfare and events. I will work closely with the welfare officer to offer any help and support, so please don't hesitate to get in touch if you have any questions or concerns! I will also be running events throughout the year, from casual tea afternoons and drinks evenings, to LGBT+ formal swaps with other colleges, to help build a sense of community within the college and the university. My goals is to make sure that everyone feels welcome and safe at John's regardless of their sexuality or gender identity!

mentalhealth.name: Bilal Qureshi
mentalhealth.bio: Hi, I'm Bilal a second-year medic, member of the College Hockey team and your Mental Health Officer for this year. Primarily, my role is to support the mental health of students across college. Cambridge can be a very taxing place at times, so I want to make it clear that it is normal to not feel 100%, and hopefully I can make it easier for everyone to access support. This will involve working with our welfare officers, Hugo and Chani, with events and drop-ins. As well as, regularly communicating the concerns of the student body to college and directing people to avenues of support. Importantly, please feel free to also contact me directly for support, through social media or if you see me in-person. I'm always happy to stop and chat even when I'm hurrying through 2nd court so please introduce yourself! The same applies if you have any suggestions or want me to raise any issues with college!

publicity.name: Elizabeth White
publicity.bio: Hi! I'm Liz and I'm a first-year English student. I'm so lucky that, as Publicity Officer, I get to make contact with pretty much every undergraduate in St John's. My role involves keeping the JCR social media pages updated, active and engaging for people. I also send out the Weekly Bulletin every Thursday so students can stay up to date with what's going on around college and what the JCR have been up to. I love seeing all the exciting campaigns and projects students are working on, so please do drop me an email if there's anything you want to see in the bulletin or on the socials. I'd also be grateful for any feedback or suggestions; my role is to communicate with you, and as long as I'm doing that well, I'm happy!

secretary.name: Sophie McInerney
secretary.bio: Hi I'm Sophie, your JCR secretary. As a third year mathmo I like to give myself a break from numbers and write the agenda and minutes of the JCR meetings, so you lovely people can keep track of what we've been up to. (Meeting minutes are kept on the JCR website). I also represent our JCR at the Cambridge Students Union meetings, so act as a bridge between university and college student initiatives. If you have questions about these, or want us to discuss something at a JCR meeting please drop me an email or stop me around college. As well as spending time helping the JCR provide top quality events, I've a become a lockdown running addict and previously involved in rowing, netball and the Adams society!

services.name: Rayyaan Hector
services.bio: I'm Rayyaan Hector, your JCR Sports, Services and Societies Officer for 2021. I am a first year Geographer at John's, playing American Football with the Cambridge University Pythons, rugby with the Redboys and football with the Poulets (albeit the 2nd XI). I've also enjoyed playing Ultimate Frisbee as a new sport to get to grips with whilst at John's. As well as all that, I see the great value in societies and their importance, once chairing and founding one myself but more than happy at the moment just to be a member of some. Ultimately, it is my role to help and support all college societies and sports teams as well as to ensure the Junior Combination Room is looked after and equipped. Feel free to drop an email, text or have a chat if you've got any questions about setting up a society/sports club, wanting to join one or if you need anything as a society/sports club. More than willing to help.

treasurer.name: Ben Foster
treasurer.bio: Hi, I'm Ben, a first year engineer and your JCR Treasurer for this year. I play hockey for the Uni 2nds and for the St John's Mogs. I manage the budgets of officers in the committee but most importantly, my role is to keep the books for the JCR's finances so that we can run smoothly. If you have any suggestions or queries about the budget or spending, then feel free to find me around college or drop me email.

mnb.name: Hugo Lloyd Williams
mnb.bio: Hey guys, I'm Hugo (he/him) and I'm your Male and Non-Binary Welfare Officer. I'm a second-year History and Politics Student, as well as being involved with college mixed netball and both university and college rugby. I'll be working with Bilal and Chani as the Mental Health and Female Welfare Officers respectively to organise welfare events, both in person and virtually, and run weekly drop-in sessions. Please email me or shoot me a message on social media if anything is on your mind, whether you have any worries or issues, ideas for student welfare or just want a relaxed chat!

fnb.name: Chani Merrel
fnb.bio: Hi I'm Chani, and I'm your female welfare officer this year! I'm a second year studying Education, English, and Drama and I love music and all things theatre. My role is to represent and support female and non-binary students at St. Johns. With Hugo, the other Welfare officer, I organise regular welfare events, online and (covid-permitting) in person, to try and keep college as happy and healthy as possible. We also provide free anonymous sexual health supplies and sanitary products for college. I'm always keen for any suggestions on how we can improve college life and am always up for a chat about anything at all.

women.name: Naomi Jennings
women.bio: Hey, I'm Naomi and I'm a fresher studying Classics. As well as being reserve on the University Challenge team and trying (within current limitations) to take part in College activities like Rowing, I'm really happy to be your Gender Equality officer for this year. My biggest aim is to continue the cultivation of our College into a welcoming and supportive environment for people of all gender identification through tackling any gender issues that arise. I will be managing the 'Consent Johns' campaign and hope to keep a high standard of education and conversation around matters of consent (as well as producing much loved stash). I also hope to increase services for women in college and work with the St John's Feminist Society on varied events. I'm always free for a chat and open to any suggestions, queries or complaints so please get in touch!
